title: Set a person’s weekly hours and split shifts
summary: Review schedule changes and handle affected appointments before saving.

sections.title: Before editing a schedule
sections.body: You need team-management access for the person’s working branches. Choose the correct location and date; displayed times follow the branch’s time zone. Opening hours and individual schedules both constrain bookability.

sections.title: Review and save working hours
sections.body:
1. Open **Team & availability**, select the person and choose **Schedule** or **Edit schedule**.
2. Under **Regular working hours**, select each working day and enter start/end times.
3. Use the add-shift control for a split day. Choose the correct branch for each shift when more than one is assigned.
4. Use **Use branch hours** or **Copy to weekdays** only after checking which days should receive those hours.
5. Select **Review changes**. Read all affected visits and open them in Calendar if needed.
6. Resolve those appointments, or select **Keep these appointments as explicit exceptions. I will manage them in Calendar.** and enter the required reason.
7. If shifts extend beyond branch hours, review and acknowledge the warning; actual bookability still follows the branch’s opening hours.
8. Select **Save reviewed schedule**.

sections.title: Check the saved week
sections.body: Return to **Weekly coverage** and inspect representative days. Schedule changes do not silently move or cancel existing visits. Staff time reserved is a scheduling measure, not payroll or attendance.

sections.title: When review needs to be repeated
sections.body: Reviews expire after 15 minutes. Changing the proposal or receiving new bookings can require a fresh review. Active holds must complete or expire before their windows can be reduced. New shifts must end after they start; overnight shift editing is not supported.
